business_problem: Rijksmuseum needed to replace fragmented CRM processes that sent inconsistent communications and prevented a holistic view of visitors across the customer journey.
solution_summary: Rijksmuseum wanted to be low tech inside the museum and high tech around it, but its CRM landscape varied by business unit and could not support personalized engagement at scale. The museum adopted a broad Dynamics 365 business-application suite so finance, marketing, education, operations, loyalty, and commerce teams could work from one customer view instead of sending overlapping messages or managing disconnected systems. Key components include Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Commerce, and Power Platform. Rijksmuseum has more tailored customer experiences, more coordinated communications, a single source of truth across departments, and a platform it can extend for new digital visitor experiences.

data_flow: Visitor and departmental data is centralized across the Dynamics 365 environment, where customer insight and engagement tools help schedule communications and personalize interactions. Commerce and finance processes stay on the same platform, and Power Platform apps extend workflows into collection management and gift-shop operations.
